title: Microcourse in French Studies; Microcourse in French Theatre.
description: Students will stage a one-act play of contemporary relevance, chosen in consultation with the instructor, for the One Stage, Many Languages: A Contemporary Global Theatre Festival hosted by the School of Languages, Literatures, and Cultures in late April 2026. Acting encouraged but not required. The play will be performed in French with English overtitles. Course taught in French and English. Must have completed FREN103 or haveequivalent experience to enroll.
